issues.description: Field SealSaloon.totalOrders: the exercise UML in problem_statement.md declares the attribute as type int (UML: -totalOrders: int at problem_statement.md line 28) while the reference solution declares the field as type long (SealSaloon.java: private long totalOrders = 0; at src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 6). This type mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about which primitive type to use and may lead to inconsistent implementations or unexpected behavior when students follow the UML literally.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and the reference implementation consistent. Either (A) update the UML and any textual references in problem_statement.md to declare totalOrders as long to match the solution, or (B) change the solution field to an int (private int totalOrders = 0;) to match the UML. Choose (A) if you expect order counts to potentially exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE; otherwise choose (B) for strict adherence to the provided UML. Update the single line in the chosen artifact (problem_statement.md line 28 or SealSaloon.java line 6) and, if applicable, adjust any explanatory text that refers to the type.
